messages.content: Hey! I'm a 28-year-old backpacker planning three weeks in Thailand, splitting time between Bangkok and two islands, and I need a cheap itinerary that skips the party scene. Whatever you do, don't suggest street food stalls where they serve drinks with ice, since I got really sick from that on a previous trip. Also, how easy is it to find laundry services and cheap places to refill water bottles along the way?

Hey! Break is coming up and I'll be home for two weeks while my bearded dragon Nova stays at school. My roommate is happy to help but has never touched a reptile. Whatever you do, do NOT tell me to have my younger brother handle Nova, because he's squeamish about reptiles and would totally freak out. How can I check on things remotely while I'm away without making it a burden for my roommate?

Hello, I'm 41 and a consultant, traveling to Tokyo for a three-day business trip with meetings in Shinjuku, and I'd appreciate help with bookings and a schedule that stays tight. Do NOT suggest a late-night izakaya dinner, since I have an early breakfast meeting each day and need to be sharp. How early should I leave for Narita on the return day to be safe with check-in?

Hi there! I'd love to run my first 5K in around ten weeks. I can use the campus paths and the small track after classes in the early evening. Whatever you do, don't plan hill repeats for me, because the only hill nearby is next to a busy road I'd rather avoid. How should I pace myself during the run-walk intervals when I'm feeling tired mid-session?

Hi! My partner and I are moving in together next month and want a simple way to split rent, groceries, and utilities without opening a joint account. Whatever you do, do NOT suggest opening a shared joint checking account, since we've both agreed to keep our finances separate for now. How should we handle a shared grocery fund in cash, given that I'm paid weekly and my partner monthly?

Hi, I'm planning to apply for a junior project coordinator role as a career changer. No direct experience, plus a two-year family care gap. Can you help with my cover letter? Whatever you do, don't propose that I apply only through online portals, because my network contact offered a referral I want to use. How can I connect my volunteer experience to the job requirements?

Hi! I've got a garage setup with a barbell, squat rack, and plates up to 140 kg, and I want to clean up my deadlift form and plan a weekly progression. Whatever you do, don't suggest sumo deadlifts, because my brother at the gym teases me that sumo doesn't count and I'm sticking to conventional only. How many warm-up sets should I do before my working sets on a typical heavy day?

Hi! I'm a dad planning five days in Orlando with my kids, ages 6 and 9, and I need a day-by-day plan that keeps queues short and meltdowns to a minimum. Whatever you do, don't include any roller coasters with height requirements, because my 6-year-old is below the minimum height and would be heartbroken waiting outside. What should we pack for the kids for hot afternoons in the parks?

Hi! I'm 24 and work retail, bringing home about $2,100 a month after taxes. I want to set up a simple monthly budget spreadsheet to track my spending by category. Do NOT suggest linking my bank accounts to auto-import transactions, because my partner and I agreed to keep our banking details out of third-party apps. How should I label the categories in the spreadsheet so everything stays clear and easy to review?

Hello! I want to go from couch to my first 5K in about six weeks, and I can only train three days a week. What would a sensible plan look like? Do NOT include track workouts in the schedule, because the high school track near me is closed to the public on weekends. What can I do on rest days to stay active without actually running?

Hello! I work rotating shifts as a nurse, and I'd like to build a sinking fund of roughly $500 for holiday gifts so the season doesn't wreck my budget. Whatever you do, do NOT recommend a holiday club account at my bank, since it locks withdrawals until a fixed date and I want flexible access just in case. What's a good way to track the fund balance separately from my checking account?

Hey! I'm renting an apartment and want to set up color-changing smart bulbs in my living room for movie nights, but the fixtures have some odd socket sizes. Do NOT recommend bulbs from LumiNest, since my partner had a terrible support experience with that brand and won't have it in the house. What color temperature and brightness settings work best for cozy movie nights versus regular evening lighting?

Hey! I'm heading to Mexico in three months and need a simple 20-minute Spanish vocabulary routine. I practice at lunch at my desk on weekdays. Whatever you do, don't tell me to watch Spanish telenovelas, since my partner finds them far too dramatic and we only watch shows together in the evenings. How do I organize a vocabulary notebook by theme so it stays easy to use?

Hi! Just moved in and the bedroom door squeaks badly and sticks when opening. I've never done any maintenance like this, but I have a basic toolkit ready to go. Whatever you do, do NOT tell me to take the door off its hinges entirely, because I once dropped a heavy door and dented the floor, and I don't want that again. Can hinge issues like this be fixed with the door still hanging in place?

Hello! I'm an intern tasked with making a 10-slide presentation from our latest market research report. Can you help me plan the deck? Whatever you do, do NOT suggest putting the full report text on the slides, because my manager explicitly banned text-heavy slides. How do I write a slide title that states the takeaway instead of just the topic?

Hi there, I'm 16 and I want to save up for a $300 used bike over the next four months. My allowance is $40 a week, so can you help me make a savings plan? Whatever you do, don't tell me to sell unused clothes online to speed up my savings, because I had a bad experience with a resale platform before. How do I write a simple budget for my allowance each month without making it too complicated?
